title: horkelia unguiculata
intro: Horkelia unguiculata, commonly known as Coastal horkelia, is a flowering plant species native to the Pacific coast of North America. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its extracts have been found to have potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Horkelia unguiculata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
